Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences Doctorate
Welcome to the doctoral studies page of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences
Are you considering a doctorate? Our faculty offers excellent conditions for your research. Whether through a graduate school or individual supervision, we support you on your path to a successful PhD.
Each year, around 200 doctoral candidates successfully complete their doctorate in various disciplines within our faculty. Here, you will find all the essential information on admission, graduate schools, completion, and contact persons. Start your academic career with us!
